preconditions: The Phase 6 authorization, command contract, exact server graph, runtime bundle, and governed profile are present.
Test identity controls are active only for loopback requests in the test environment.
The optional LiveView adapter compatibility descriptor matches the pinned candidate versions.
steps: Drive the server action through normalized DOM event, Elixir runtime intent, browser transport, Phoenix, server authority, audit, public result, and DOM update.
Repeat an identical idempotency request and exercise stale, rate, unauthorized, expired, transaction, server, disconnect, timeout, retry, and disposal outcomes.
Exercise exact/mismatched adapter descriptors, full/diff patch ordering, reconnect, stale/duplicate data, and explicit fallback.
Run standalone browser fixture, DOM adapter, Plug closure, headless boundary, import, cleanup, and evidence checks.
expected_results: Only server-owned identity, authorization, current state, and idempotency can permit one effect.
Denied and failed commands produce no unauthorized effect or secret-bearing diagnostic.
Adapter mismatch disables the optional path and preserves standalone DOM.
Final browser/runtime/transport/DOM ownership is bounded and the Phase 6 evidence remains unsupported feasibility.
prohibited_results: Client role, presentation, or private renderer data grants authority.
A replay, stale request, failure, late result, or disposal repeats or applies an unauthorized effect.
LiveView coupling enters the standalone DOM, runtime fixture, server authority, Plug profile, headless profile, or portable package.
The result is represented as production identity, persistence, browser support, or a stable component/renderer contract.
